description: This file defines the SignatureInterface, an interface for AWS request signing strategies used in the AWS SDK for PHP. It declares methods for signing requests and creating pre-signed URLs, serving as an abstraction for different signing protocols.

classes.name: SignatureInterface
classes.description: An interface that defines methods for signing AWS requests, allowing multiple signing strategies to be implemented interchangeably.

methods.name: signRequest
methods.description: Signs the specified HTTP request with AWS credentials, adding necessary authorization headers, and returns the modified request.

methods.name: presign
methods.description: Generates a pre-signed request URL that expires after a specified time, using provided AWS credentials.
